analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds 'constant or variable frame rate' to the inline video_url description (line 52). Lines 52 and 3 fall outside the supplied units 405-1309, which are base text only. I examined the supplied base text for security-relevant documentation, including logout and token revocation, the drain lifecycle, enroll and App Attest guidance, prefix-cache and KV guidance, and model cache location. None of it is modified, and no source code, mitigation or trust-boundary behavior changes. The variable-frame-rate wording touches the inline video decode path. That path relates to T-050, where plaintext video is exposed through provider temporary files. The doc patch does not show whether the VFR decode implementation uses temp files, so any code change behind this wording sits outside the supplied evidence. If a companion code change adds VFR handling, the next pass should check that it keeps the in-memory, no-temp-file handling from the T-050 fix, and bounds frame count and decode resources (T-010/DoS). This is an unverified contract, not a finding. No threat model assumptions are invalidated by the docs-only change as supplied.
